about: A terrain .meshgraph from a spec, the same shape as the demo scenes: a Landscape heightmap (Landscape tab, or: noiser --headless --landscape-export Hills.landscape ../Terrains/Hills.png) cut into 4x4 Nanite chunks, boulders scattered on it by slope, then planar UVs and baked normal/occlusion maps. Needs ../Terrains/Hills.png (not shipped: too big for the repo). Lengths are in centimetres because unit_cm is 1.
